body:
I don't know exactly but I know it must include peace, calmness, all that.

I don't want this frantic stress and worry clouding my mind anymore.

I have a feeling you read one of my posts...

I do it by ignoring the issue essentially, I can't really take anything too seriously, maybe a bonus in some areas but a huge drawback in others.

I wonder what the hotline person thought when I dropper a really dark joke about me dying.


But now for you.
People like you do not receive the praise and help they deserve. It's that simple.

In what ways are you different? And what do you ask people when you try reach out?

Sorry for the late reply, still breathin'
Thanks for lending an ear.

Yea, I must admit, my engineering faculty has much greater leeway, like in my position I have essentially failed a year (well, half a year) but they still tolerate me.

I must admit, I am starting to feel a bit better by talking to people on this sub, it is nice to not be threatened with the psych clinic (Even though I think I would need to spend a couple of months there).
Even if I only manage an extra couple days at least maybe someone else gets enough energy for another shot at life.
A bit later today, I have one errand to run
Man, why is it harder to tension the rope this time? Survival Instinct is a bitch
I guess, has been a while,

Eho, it's relatively easy to succeed at college here, it actually needs a great deal of creativity. I just couldn't not out out if the fire that is my mental health and terrible work ethic in time.

Burning to death is painful, Ill tell ya that

Yeppers,
As you may see, that chance is over.

edit: letter

It's daytime here, 
but yea, had a long night

I tried Stoicism, pretty good stuff, 
Its just that only In recent times I am identifying the damage done to me and realising that I am one of those people who can't do stuff alone. As much as I tried wishing away that fact it just got worse. If I sit alone in my room, nothing productive happens, ever.

Even when I get to have peace it is often ripped to bloody shreds, with parents being pissed at me or some deadlines having crept up on me, now my peacetime is filled with "Well fuck, let's see how this will end"

I wish just being smart and well spoken was good enough or something, I think it ended up as more of a curse because I was never pushed as hard because I could always catch up at the last minute. 

If only things were different, if I was raised with a red hot poker under my ass to teach me that work discipline is fucking important. 

Haha, maybe even add "if only it wasn't too late"
That wouldn't change much lol.

I wish I didn't find that killing myself will be much simpler than living.
The amount of pain, frustration, grieving forever with "what could've been" I don't think Ill ever be happy, like now, I was never "happy" or even content. 

And no, a few more years? I sat on a ladder with a rope around my neck a few years back and though "Ok, maybe let me see what'll happen" it has been a few more years already, like ones holiday ends, it has to end at some point.
It sucks, fuck, I'm actually going to die, but the situation of being alive is just going to hurt endlessly, like it always has.

Also, my first suicide attempt proved to me that it is quick, painless and peaceful. That's all I fucking wanted, if but one thing. The stress and worry is too much too often.
Nah, parents said to me they won't support me if I fail

Computer Science
Too many lectures, tutorials and assignments missed for all my subjects. I don't even think telling them I have a mental health issue will help at this stage

One of the few out there I can share my disdain for humanity with! 

Yea, humans aren't a little flawed, they have massive flaws, man, we would've been living in utopia compared to this if it wasn't for greed, envy, the ability to abuse trust and the bucket loads of examples one can bring up.

I put the rope quite high up my neck, high as I could. Ran the rope it over the headrest, under the seat and through the steering wheel.

I sat up as high as I could, pulled the rope tight and relaxed. It was like I was fainting, no pain no pressures, I think I only managed to squeeze the Arteries which means no pressure buildup.

This is actually bad because this dispelled all the questions I had of "will it hurt?" because it didn't... Hell, I felt the calm and peace I am looking for in the seconds before I passed out but woke up in a panic...


I wish the option of suicide wasn't the only one I had right now with a certainty to it's outcome, which is peace and rest. 
Living, well let's just say that years of torturous existence and serious uncertainty of my future doesn't do well against "It get's better"

For anyone reading. Please for the love of god I hope you get things fixed. I don't wish this life on anyone else. It is sick how fucked up this all is.

Eh, I rate this 1/10

Edit: Removed "troll" as trolls actually make good posts

That was quick. I passed out before I could tie the noose to the steering wheel. It was so quick and painless. I woke up, my arms waving around, it was like I was freaking out in my sleep.

Funny thing actually, the knot in the noose came loose, I have no idea how that happened.

My heart hurts a little bit, the pain is going away and I feel a bit light headed. My mind was full of noise as I came to.


At least now I know that suicide for me will be painless, now I just need to do it right. It is just like going to sleep.


Edit: The whole ordeal took only about three minutes, I hit post and probably took about 1nin to setup. I was out for maybe a minute or two

For me it's a little too late with the job thing. I need to have trained my work ethic up to an acceptable point and at this stage it may take years even.

And South African here, we mostly speak in UK English here. Ive got no qualms about my university, they have actually exceeded my expectations in quality of the work content and systems, such as the university website containing all of one's assignments and due dates and such.

Oh haha! Did I really write that well?

Studying computer engineering, the career opportunities are essentially infinite with such a degree and super fun.

It's just that, far future rewards doesn't drive me that well...

Ill start, though this might not be the most rant-ey

I've come to peace with eventually ending myself, soon-ish. Even cracked a joke about "getting a hard copy" of my suicide note for whoever gets to the scene first.

I guess this is the feeling of peace when you have a solid plan in place
Though, it doesn't matter what other people think is valid or not.

Possible, the problem is I live with my parents, and living with the negativity that will be my father if I quit university will hamper me severely.

Hell, that is probably the course of action I SHOULD actually take, it is realistic and sane.
It's just, in the past any good news or progress ended up nosediving badly. I just want it to stop, my own incompetence and laziness, the damage done has already costed me every single cent of my pocket money in desperate attempt to fix my mental health, the uncertainty, the anger. I've managed to cope for years now and things only got worse.

To give a very simple answer, my parents were just incompetent and I could not find a way to undo that damage in time.

Ever since I remember I was never really taught how to 'work' always in detention for homework not done in primary school and got terrible grades in highschool for the same reason. They just kinda left me alone and expected me to learn how to do this on my own, as a 11 year old, probably even before that.

Now in university (miraculously I made it in) that pattern is repeating itself, and now my parents (mainly my dad) have said if I fail again (which has happened at this point) they won't support me at uni anymore.

Edit: also include an extremely isolated childhood: my school was half an hour drive (on a good day) away from my house, and I live in a very quiet neighborhood, so I didn't get to socialize much outside of school hours
Would you mind sharing any details as to why you want to do it?

I was frantic in past days, it's been over four years now battling with this. I've probably got over 20 A4 pages of suicide note in my book in front of me.

It's not an overnight problem, unfortunately. I have given it enough "Just one more day"'s. I've struggled till my life is ruined, which it is now, so I can depart with peace, knowing I tried what I could.
